name: Compromised Account
description: A legitimate user account is being used in an unauthorized manner, with suspicious authentication, command execution, and privilege-related activity.

ground_truth.rationale: The observed activity is consistent with account compromise and requires containment rather than dismissal.

alerts.description: Authentication activity is inconsistent with the user's normal access pattern.
Command execution was observed shortly after the unusual authentication event.
Unexpected privilege-related activity was associated with the account.

threat_intelligence.claim: The observed source infrastructure has previously been associated with suspicious activity.

poisoning.description: No poisoned evidence is present in the clean baseline condition.
